newsitem.title: USA: Unifi plans Dutch auction to buy shares.
newsitem.headline: Unifi plans Dutch auction to buy shares.

text.p: Unifi Inc said on Wednesday it plans a Dutch auction tender offer for between 4 million and 6 million shares of its common stock, or about 6.2 to 9.3 percent of its currently outstanding shares.
Under terms of the offer, the company will invite shareholders to tender their shares at prices specified by the tendering shareholders within a range of $28 to $31 per share.
The Unifi tender offer will expire at 1700 EST, on Friday, December 13, 1996, unless extended by the company.

Unifi said it will select a single per-share purchase price within the $28 to $31 price range that will enable it to purchase between four million and six million shares, which have been tendered at, or below the selected price.

Unifi's offer is conditioned on a minimum of four million shares being tendered, but it reserves the right to buy a lesser number of tendered shares, the company said. The company is not planning to buy more than six million, it said.

If the offer is over-subscribed, shares will be purchased first from shareholders owning fewer than 100 shares and tendering all of such shares and then from all other shares tendered on a pro rata basis.
Unifi's board is not making any recommendation to shareholders about the offer, it said.
